parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management version [parameter1]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management version standard
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 配置以太网连接故障管理（CFM）的版本为标准版本。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] level [parameter2]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 level 0

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] ma [parameter2]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 ma ma3
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 配置CFM管理域内的维护关联（MA）。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 ma ma3 mep 3
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 配置维护关联内的维护端点（MEP）。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] direction [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 ma ma3 mep 3 direction outward

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ccm [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 ma ma3 mep 3 ccm enable
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 启用维护端点的连续性检查消息（CCM）。

parameters.name: ccm
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查消息的状态，例如enable。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ccm-interval [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 ma ma3 mep 3 ccm-interval 1s
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 配置维护端点的连续性检查消息（CCM）的发送间隔。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] ma [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3] ccm [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 ma ma3 remote-mep 4 ccm enable
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 启用远程维护端点的连续性检查消息（CCM）。

parameters.name: ccm
parameters.explanation: 连续性检查消息的状态，例如enable。

set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.template: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] loss-measurement single-ended receive-test [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.command: set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-fault-management domain md3 ma ma3 mep 3 loss-measurement single-ended receive-test test1
set protocols oam ethernet connectivity-.explanation: 配置维护端点的单端丢失测量接收测试。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching port-mode [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching port-mode trunk
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换端口模式为trunk。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan members [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family et.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members vlan2

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
